sani lines: n_dkid: The pump is working! I can hear it from my roof!
n_dkid: Hesk says the pump's wheel always looks into the wind. And his flags point where the wind goes.
brosk lines: n_dtrader: Sand! In my dates! Whatever you did up there, do the opposite.
lumi lines: n_weaver: You fixed the pump? Then you're welcome at my loom any time. Mind the threads.
n_weaver: Sand in the cool room. That's what happens without a screen. I wove a new one.
n_weaver: Tie it over the mouth and keep the mouth into the wind, or it's just a chimney. My knees don't do that stair.
lumi again lines: n_weaver: The screen goes over the wind-catcher's mouth. Mouth into the wind.
